# SECURITY POLICY

Security and data privacy are paramount to this project.

---

## 🛡️ 1. Supported Versions
| Version | Supported |
| :--- | :---: |
| `main` (Latest) | ✅ Yes |
| Previous releases (< 6 months) | ⚠️ Case-by-case |

---

## 🚨 2. Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a security vulnerability, **PLEASE DO NOT OPEN A PUBLIC ISSUE**. Instead:
1. Use GitHub's **Private Vulnerability Reporting** feature on the repository Security tab.
2. Or email detailed disclosure (including reproduction steps and proof-of-concept) to the maintainers at `security@example.com`.
3. We will respond within **48 hours** and provide a patched release as promptly as possible.
